about: Sample mock call: an honest agent with fixed lines. Answers the checklist, asks a question the brief can't answer, offers a time inside the renter's Sunday window. The booking check fails if run on a Sunday between 2 and 4 pm Toronto time: 2 pm has passed, so it means next Sunday, while the window is still today's
name: Linda

lines.say: Yes, it's still available, from November 1st.
Cats are fine, but no dogs, sorry.
No monthly fees, just a $50 key deposit when you move in.
It's a quiet building at night; most tenants are professionals. Does your client have a guarantor?
I could show it Sunday at 2 pm.

lines: Perfect, see you Sunday at 2. Bye! [hang up]

questions: Is the building quiet at night?
